unresolvedConflicts.subject: Manager-universe scope
unresolvedConflicts.issue: The supplied FUND_MANIFEST marks Asterion Industrial Partners as knownManager=false with canonicalManager=null, while official regulatory and manager sources establish a live infrastructure investment manager under the legal name Asterion Industrial Partners SGEIC, S.A. The output contract therefore prevents any manager or fund proposal in this census.
unresolvedConflicts.recommendedResolution: The manifest owner should review the manager-universe scope outside this census. No automatic manager or fund addition is proposed; rerun only if a canonical manager is subsequently authorized.

notes: Scope-only result required because the supplied snapshot sets knownManager=false and canonicalManager=null.
Official manager identity, Fund I through Fund III close materials, current portfolio geography and exit status, and co-investment treatment were reviewed.
The repository snapshot contains no fund rows, so no matched or repo-only records were required.
No inaccessible source was relied upon.
